Devereux Texas runs residential and community programs for children and youth with autism and developmental disabilities, consistent with a nonpublic school / special education master contract

ProPublica lists Devereux Foundation (EIN 23-1390618, Villanova, PA) as a 501(c)(3) whose filings include an Executive Director, Texas; the Texas pages name Devereux as the parent organization (Villanova, PA)

profile.summary: Devereux Texas is the League City, Texas campus of Devereux Advanced Behavioral Health, a nonprofit provider of behavioral health and developmental disability services. It runs a residential program for youth ages 6-17 with autism and intellectual and developmental disabilities, plus community-based autism services and outpatient behavior analysis.
